name: Add the constant-product impermanent-loss formula IL(r) = 2√r/(1+r) − 1
description: Impermanent loss IL(r) = 2√r/(1+r) − 1 for constant-product AMM LPs, with IL(r) ≤ 0 and equality iff r = 1.

code.lean:
import MathFin.DeFi.ImpermanentLoss

open MathFin

/-- Impermanent loss IL(r) = 2√r/(1+r) − 1 for constant-product AMM LPs, with IL(r) ≤ 0 and equality iff r = 1. -/
theorem mf_defi_impermanent_loss (x₀ y₀ : ℝ) (hx₀ : 0 < x₀) (hy₀ : 0 < y₀) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) :
    DeFi.newReserveX x₀ r * DeFi.newReserveY y₀ r = x₀ * y₀ ∧
      DeFi.internalPrice (DeFi.newReserveX x₀ r) (DeFi.newReserveY y₀ r)
        = r * DeFi.internalPrice x₀ y₀ ∧
      0 < DeFi.newReserveX x₀ r ∧ 0 < DeFi.newReserveY y₀ r ∧
      DeFi.impermanentLoss x₀ y₀ r = 2 * Real.sqrt r / (1 + r) - 1 ∧
      DeFi.impermanentLoss x₀ y₀ r ≤ 0 ∧
      (DeFi.impermanentLoss x₀ y₀ r = 0 ↔ r = 1) :=
  MathFin.defi_impermanent_loss_formula x₀ y₀ hx₀ hy₀ r hr
